BrochureContent.Content:
Kelly Hudson Properties present this beautifully presented 3 bedroomed  semi detached property, offering bright and spacious accommodation throughout c.141.26 c.1520sqft .This property is in excellent condition and the accommodation briefly comprises of 3 Bedrooms– master ensuite, kitchen/dining room, family room, play room, storage room, office, utility, guest WC, sitting room and family bathroom.

Located in a much sought after area, within walking distance of the town centre and 
all local amenities including shops, schools, church, restaurants and pubs. Ideal family home.

Edenderry is an ideal commuter town, just 20kms from the M4 access at Enfield and  daily bus services to Dublin and Tullamore. Viewing is highly recommended and sure to impress!

ACCOMMODATION:

Hallway: Coving, light fittings, procelain tiles

Kitchen: Ceramic tiles, light fitting, fitted kitchen, stainless steel skin, America fridge, integrated dishwasher, oven, hob, extractor fan

Storage room off kitchen

Utility: Ceramic tiles, light fittings, fitted units, stainless sink, area fully plumbed

Guest WC: Tiled floor, WHB,WC , light fitting

Sittingroom: Coving, feature fireplace, stove, feature bay window, wooden floor, TV point

Family Room: Wooden floor, light fitting, french doors leading to garden

Office:  Wooden  floor, shelving

Play Room: Light fitting, wooden floor

Bathroom: Tiled floor, bath, tile surround, WHB, WC

Bedroom 1: Light fitting, walk in wardrobe– shelved &  railed, blinds, TV point, window seat

Ensuite: Electric shower, power shower, WHB, WC, tiled from floor to ceiling

Bedroom 2: Light fitting, fitted wardrobe, wooden floor

Bedroom 3: Light fitting, fitted wardrobe, wooden floor
